info.name: JFrog Pipelines REST API
info.description:
API for managing CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows. JFrog Pipelines provides continuous integration and delivery automation natively integrated with the JFrog Platform for building, testing, and deploying software.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
